payload.description_html: Restoration of the Romualdo Formation environment. Foreground: the spinosaurid theropod Irritator challengeri, background right: the small theropod Mirischia asymmetrica being fended off by the pterosaur Thallasodromeus sethi, above the coastline are two pterosaurs in flight.
